top_issues: Total balance $115.00 dominates correctly, but the 'At risk $115.00' purple label is a first-timer red flag with no plain-language counterpart
Breakdown text 'On-chain $0.00 / Reserve $0.00 / Secured $0.00' is small and reads as a list of zeros, not reassuring
'Instant: send up to $215.00, receive up to $0.50' uses small mixed-case text that's easy to miss
fixes: Add a single plain-language sentence under balance: 'This is in a Hub account, not on-chain.'
Bump breakdown labels to 14px and add commas to all money values
Make the instant-cap line an 14px secondary callout, not 11px note

top_issues: Account card is clean but 'send up to 215.00 / receive up to 0.50' is tiny and couples two asymmetric metrics confusingly
Recent-items bars (green/violet) are unlabeled in the list itself — the legend only lives on the Account screen
Empty space under 'Open account' makes the card feel unbalanced
fixes: Raise capacity-caption text to 13px with 'send'/'receive' as separate aligned columns
Add an inline mini-legend to Recent list or color-label the bars
Reduce card padding and add 'All activity' as a full-width link

top_issues: 'To' section shows a 64-char hash split across two lines plus a truncated one — long addresses should collapse to a single copyable line
'Fee 0.000050 USDC' and 'You send 25.00' use unformatted long decimals that read poorly on mobile
Route chips (You → H1 → H2) are clear but the 'Fee 0.000075' second option is not visually distinct enough
fixes: Show '0x92c2…cbf0' with a copy icon; reveal full hash on tap
Format fees as '0.00005' and amounts with commas: '25.00'
Add a 'recommended' badge or border to the cheaper route option

top_issues: Same long-address/fee formatting problems carry over
'This payment 25.00' label row is 11px against a 40px amount — a weak hierarchy for the actual cost being confirmed
'Add a note' is orphaned at the bottom, easy to overlook before the Pay button
fixes: Merge address onto one line with copy affordance
Raise 'This payment' label to 14px bold grey
Move 'Add a note' into the amount card or above the CTA

top_issues: Strongest screen: green check, 'PAID', 25.00 USDC, Frame #180, Proof, 'Verified by your runtime' — excellent trust
'in 60832ms' is a raw engineering metric a consumer won't parse; it looks like a bug or a latency boast
Settled/time uses a 12-hour clock with 'in 60832ms' jammed together
fixes: Replace 'in 60832ms' with 'Instant settlement' or drop it
Show 'Settled 05:28:03' and move frame/proof to a compact 'Details' row
Add a 'Share receipt' secondary action below Done

top_issues: Modal dims the underlying home nicely, but backdrop text is still slightly legible and competes for attention
'Frame #180' and 'Proof 0x34dc…4966' are trustworthy but a first-time user won't know what a frame is
fixes: Darken backdrop to 80% so the receipt is unmissable
Add a one-line tooltip: 'A frame is a signed receipt of this payment'

fixes: Shrink QR to ~200px and put amount/account controls beside it
Raise capacity label to 13px with a small info icon
Pre-fill amount or show 'Enter amount' placeholder instead of 0.00

top_issues: Good share affordances (Copy invoice / Copy link / xln:// app link), but 'Copy invoice' and 'Copy link' look identical in intent

Show entity ID truncated with copy icon, full on tap
Move the 'Anyone can pay this id' explainer above the Entity ID box

'You receive' shows 0.00 with a limit-price/order explanation that reads as a wall of text for a swap action

Split the bar into two labeled 'send'/'receive' axes

top_issues: Credit-line table (Their credit line to you 0.00 / Your credit line to them 115.50 / Collateral 100.00) is genuinely the right data for risk, but 'they owe you +90.00' and the table are two separate framings

Keep the explainer but move to a collapsible 'What does this mean?'
Raise the empty-lanes link size

top_issues: Clean, consistent, good filters (All/Payments/Swaps/Settlement/…) and Export CSV
'5 movements' count is small grey near Export CSV — easy to miss the total
No 'export proof' affordance here beyond a single CSV link; the receipt detail carries the proof

Add a secondary 'Export receipts' action tied to proof output
Keep date headers ('TODAY') — they help scannability

'2 committed entries' and 'Frames' are expert terms — a freelancer won't parse them
The Proof hash is truncated but there's no copy action in the modal

Rename 'Frames 2 committed entries' to '2 signed receipts' for clarity

top_issues: Dollars-per-pixel scale is a genuinely novel, well-explained concept ('Every bar is drawn to this one scale') and the Auto/$1/$2/$5/$10/$25/$100 chips are clear
The three toggles (On-chain/Reserve/Accounts) each carry a 2-line explanation — good but heavy
The scale slider and chips make the screen feel like a developer/analyst tool rather than a wallet
fixes: Collapse the three toggles' text into one-line tooltips
Keep the scale concept, but label it 'Bar scale' and add a preview bar
Reduce vertical padding so Appearance sits higher

top_issues: Vault section (Reveal recovery phrase / Lock / Forget vault) is a strong, honest security surface
The 'AT THIS SCALE' $100/$1,000/$10,000/$100,000 chart is clever but only a sampling, and '1 px = $10' coupling is abstract
The runtime/frame/imported-vault rows are dense and jargon-heavy for a settings screen
fixes: Add a 'Why set a scale?' one-liner
Keep the vault security actions prominent
Move runtime/ledger technical rows into a collapsible 'Technical' section

top_issues: From/To cards (Wallet/Reserve/Account) are an excellent mental model and the selected-state is clear
'Amount exceeds what is available here' red error is good, but 'up to 0.00 USDC' right-aligned is a confusing zero
Sign & send is correctly disabled, but the checkbox affordance reads as an unchecked box rather than 'select to enable'
fixes: Show source available balance as 'up to 190.00 USDC' when the source is Account
Replace the checkbox with a clearly labeled 'Enable' toggle
Add a shield note: 'This moves funds between your own accounts, not to a counterparty'

top_issues: Continuation with same zero-up-to issue
'What happens: Fund you through H1 — Reserve to account posts collateral on-chain' is a helpful plain explanation but buried at the very bottom
No explicit 'move between accounts is instant and free' reassurance near the CTA
fixes: Move 'What happens' above the Sign & send button
Add inline 'Instant · no fee' next to the source card
Fix the zero 'up to' label

top_issues: 'Where your money stands' is the single best trust element in the app: Total / Yours whatever a hub does / Promised by hubs (violet) / You owe — and the green/violet explainer below it
The capability grid (Sovereignty/Move/Assets/Lending/Ownership) is clean but 'Sovereignty' and 'Ownership' are abstract words
'Nothing waiting on you' is a great reassurance line
fixes: Keep 'Where your money stands' as a permanent frame on Manage
Rename Sovereign→'Control' and Ownership→'Own' with an icon pairing for first-timers
Add the prompt 'Move money into a wallet or reserve to make it enforceable' as a next step

top_issues: On-chain wallet view is clean: Signer / Depository / Gas 0.1000 ETH / USDC-WETH-USDT each with Depositary may pull 0.00
'Depositary may pull 0.00' is an important safety signal but triple-repeated reads as clutter
No unify across the two '0.00' totals — the reader must infer nothing is on-chain
fixes: Drop the repeated 'may pull' line per token and put a single global 'Depositary may pull 0.00 total' note
Add a one-line 'On-chain is slow; use Pay/Accounts for instant' tip
Make Refresh a more visible action

top_issues: Debts explainer ('A debt appears when a settlement or dispute closes with more owed than there was collateral') is honest but reads as a warning with no counterpart reassurance
Faucets section is cut off at the bottom, incomplete in this view
The screen is text-heavy with low visual interest
fixes: Pair the debts note with 'You currently have no debts' in green
Make faucets a full card with a clear 'Get test USDC' button
Add an icon to the debts section for scannability

top_issues: Hub (H1 · 3 lanes) / Token (USDC/WETH/USDT) / Lend/Borrow tabs are clear and conventional
'Interest you ask · basis points 100 = 1.00% per term' is a nice computed assist
Term chips (1 hour/1 day/1 month) are good but the active '1 day' chip's border is subtle
fixes: Strengthen active-chip border/background contrast
Add 'APY' framing next to '1.00% per term' for comparability
Surface the hub pool APY so the lender sees the offer vs current pool rate

top_issues: 'Offer to the pool' button is greyed/disabled-looking (dim blue with muted text) yet the amount is 0.00 — the disabled state is confusing because the pool data below is also zeros
'Your offer sits in the hub pool…' is a good plain explanation but reads as fine print
H1 Pool table (Available/Borrowed/Active principal) shows all 0.00 with no visual cue it's empty
fixes: Make the disabled CTA say 'Enter amount to enable' so the state is legible
Raise the pool explanation to 13px
Show 'Pool is empty — be the first lender' in the pool table

top_issues: Lowest-scoring screen, largely due to density and jargon: 'Entity 0xda113f90…8f0f92', 'Kind Lazy (hash of its board)', 'Threshold 1 of 1', 'Signer 0xc449aa1e…22603f you'
'A lazy entity is identified by the hash of its board. Register it on the EntityProvider to issue shares' is impenetrable to anyone but a protocol engineer
'Take control of another entity' box shows an informative empty state but is wasted vertical space
fixes: Rewrite the lazy-entity explainer in one plain sentence: 'This account is owned by the keys in this wallet; threshold 1 of 1 means any one of them can sign.'
Collapse or remove the 'Take control' empty state on mobile
Shorten the entity/signer hashes with copy icons

top_issues: Second-best trust screen: 'Enforceable right now $0.00' plus green/violet legend and a plain explanation ('Green is yours whatever anyone does… Violet is what a counterparty owes you on their signature alone')
'Trust only $90.00' is technically precise but the word 'trust' implies fragility to a skeptic, and the dominant $0.00 number reads as 'worthless'
The green/violet color semantic is excellent but color-only — not accessible for color-blind users
fixes: Add text/icon labels next to green and violet in addition to color
Reframe 'Trust only $90.00' as 'Hub credit $90.00 — enforceable by signature, not on-chain'
Keep 'Enforceable right now' as the headline — it is the strongest differentiator in the app

top_issues: KEYS/LEDGER/PER COUNTERPARTY sections are strong and 'Save evidence bundle' is a genuinely useful security action
'nothing at risk · co-signed · proof on file · they answer in 1d, you in 1d' is dense and mixes risk state with a response-time SLA — hard to parse
No explicit 'Start dispute' action exists, only 'Save evidence bundle' and a per-counterparty status line
fixes: Split the counterparty line: risk state on one line, SLA on another
Add a 'Dispute' action button next to 'Save evidence bundle' for a misbehaving hub
Rename 'Accounts co-signed 1 of 1' to 'Both parties signed' for clarity

overall.verdict: A visually consistent, honest self-custody wallet with genuinely excellent trust surfaces (Enforceable right now, Where your money stands, per-frame proof) and best-in-class price/risk data legibility, but it drowns first-timers and skeptics in jargon, micro-text, and alarming 'at risk'/'trust only' framing. Fix decimal precision, reframe risk language, and add a plain-language first-run explainer to turn strong design into broad user satisfaction.
priority_fixes: Format all money to readable precision — '0.04 WETH' not '0.039992000000000000 WETH', commas for large amounts (helps Anya, Maya, Marcus, Fatima)
Reframe risk wording — replace 'At risk' / 'Trust only' / 'trust only $90' with 'Hub credit' / 'Hub-backed' plus a one-line honest definition (helps Maya, Dmitri, Tomasz)
Add a plain-language first-run explainer on Home — 'Your $115 is in a Hub account; $0 is on-chain. Hub payments are instant; on-chain is slow' (helps Maya, Sofia, Dmitri)
Provide a visible Dispute action and challenge countdown per hub account (helps Kenji, Marcus)
Raise all micro-text to 13–14px — fees (0.000050 USDC), capacity captions ('send up to 215.00'), 'This payment 25.00', and long hashes truncated with copy icons (helps every mobile user)

Entity ID / frame / credit line jargon on Receive and Payment screens (04, 02)

personas.name: Tomasz

personas.name: Fatima

'Across networks' tab on 05-swap.png is inactive — no detail shown

personas.name: Dmitri
personas.verdict: This is genuinely different — 'Enforceable right now', 'Where your money stands', per-frame signatures — and I can see why it's safer than a custodial wallet. But 'at risk' and 'trust only' wording spooks me, and the jargon density is high.
blockers: 'At risk $115.00' and 'Trust only $90.00' trigger alarm without immediate positive framing (01-home.png, 15-sovereignty.png)
Entity/runtime/frame jargon density across Manage, Ownership, Settings
Color-only green/violet risk semantics — not accessible and not obvious to a first-scanner
